chapter.heading: For the music director. A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
May the
Lord answer you when you are in trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

May the
Lord send you help from the sanctuary, and may he support you from Zion.

May the
Lord remember all your offerings, and accept all your burnt sacrifices. Selah.

May the
Lord give you whatever you really want; may he make all your plans successful.

May we
shout for joy over your victory, and set up banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your requests.

Now I
know that the Lord saves the one he has anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, and save his anointed by his powerful right hand.

Some trust
in chariots and some in war horses, but we trust in who the Lord our God is.

They collapse
and fall down, but we rise and stand up.

May the
Lord save the king! Please answer us when we call for help!
